data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse and Germanic roots, Ing means 'God' or 'Divine Power'. In Norse mythology, Ing was the name of a god associated with fertility, agriculture, and peace. In Christianity, this name can be seen as a reminder of God's presence and power in our lives. The name Ing carries the meaning “God, Divine Power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ing usually hope their child will grow to embody god, divine power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and connection to the divine.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ing total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
